name: PetPivot
summary: PetPivot builds cheap, deliberately simple open-top self-cleaning boxes under the AutoScooper name: no app, no account and no subscription. In a category where every rival is racing to add cameras, building something deliberately dumb and putting the money into safety sensors instead is a defensible position.
strengths: Serious safety hardware at a budget price
No app, no account, no subscription
Takes ordinary bags and ordinary clumping litter
weaknesses: No smart tracking of any kind
Interior is tight for large breeds
